 HONG KONG SAR – Media OutReach Newswire – 17 November 2026 – Guizhou Laishigang Liquor Co., Ltd. ("Laishigang Liquor"), a fifth-generation, century-old sauce-aroma baijiu producer certified as a "Guizhou Time-Honored Brand," today announced its strategic plan to establish Hong Kong as its Asia-Pacific operational and brand promotion hub. Leveraging this base, the company is launching a comprehensive internationalization blueprint targeting the Southeast Asian Chinese market as its next core destination for overseas expansion.
 Ms. Zita Lai, fifth-generation inheritor of Guizhou Laishigang Liquor and Chairwoman of Lai's Family Spirits International Trading Limited, announces plans to use Hong Kong as an Asia-Pacific hub to expand into Southeast Asian and global markets.
